exposure: intramuscular (IM) dexamethasone injections before an elective caesarean delivery at term
outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: 674 singleton pregnancies between 37+0 and 38+6 weeks gestation undergoing elective caesarean section
finding: Halving the dose of dexamethasone to 12mg for term elective caesarean section deliveries did not show any significant benefit in reducing neonatal respiratory morbidities.
mod_finding: The study investigated the effect of a lower dose of dexamethasone on neonatal outcomes after elective caesarean section.
